review:
Bells of Fortune is a Wazdan jackpot slot with two different bonus rounds. It plays on 16 separate reels. Land 4 Bonus symbols on the central reels for Hold the Jackpot, where you get 3 respins to fill the grid. Cash Infinity symbols are especially handy on those central four spots because they stick and make the trigger more likely.

The second bonus comes from filling the Bells Matrix across all reels. You pick gates to reveal prizes, and Click 2 Grand gives a shot at the Grand Jackpot. Both rounds top out at 1,000x. High volatility, 96.1% RTP, and Chance Level offers three bet multipliers. Similar to 12 Bells, but with a pick-style second bonus. Play the Bells of Fortune demo free to see both bonuses.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
